description: Web search results as JSON: up to 30 organic results with rank, title, URL, domain and snippet, ads removed. Optional region (us-en, mx-es, de-de...) and recency filter (past day, week, month or year). No account, no key, no per-query quota to manage. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

region.description: Region-language code such as us-en, mx-es, gb-en, de-de; wt-wt for no region (default)
